correctness.rationale: The nine-case one-more-subspace witness table is justified using lines, hyperplanes, bounds and chains; it depends only on ranks of A, B, their intersection and ambient dimension, never field order. The complete pair type F is reduced in both independent coordinate splits to the 3+3 clipped dimensions, using precisely two boundary identities and saturation above two. Pointed rank-two formulas recover the 3-clipped rank and corank, yielding seven distinct unpointed rank-three classes and stabilization at ambient dimension six. Gaussian binomial values give the sharp 2825 bound. Embedded program compares exact witness masks with actually enumerated finite subspace lattices and checks all table and reduction boundary identities, but computational samples do not establish the universal result independently.
